primaryChecks.text: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
contextRefs: JOS 19:1 — The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.

before.subtitleJa: ベエル・シェバの異読として保留
before.summaryJa: ヨシュア記19:2の固定WEBPは「Beersheba (or Sheba)」と記し、別の町ではなく同じ箇所の異読として示します。既存のベエル・シェバの項目と重複するため、この候補は独立した地名カードにしません。
